findings.description: The code uses i2c_dev implicitly (through Adafruit_I2CRegister) without ensuring it is initialized.
The read path does not report or check I2C transfer success.
C-style cast (HUSB238_ResponseCodes) pdBits.read() converts raw, untrusted hardware bits to an enum without validation.
If the enum value is later used to index a table/state-machine, a bogus enum could cause out-of-bounds access.
